# Mault

> Mault is an open-source automated trading card sorter and scanner made by Mault LLC. A 3D printed machine feeds cards past a camera, the Mault app identifies each card from its image (with text recognition as a backup), and servos drop it into the bin your rules choose. The app then tracks where every card is stored and what the collection is worth.

Mault supports Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon (English and Japanese), Yu-Gi-Oh!, Disney Lorcana, One Piece Card Game, Flesh and Blood, Star Wars: Unlimited, Digimon Card Game, Gundam Card Game, Grand Archive, Sorcery: Contested Realm and Riftbound.

Key facts:

- Sorting: bin rules on any card field (color, rarity, set, type, price and more), plus alphabetical, chaos and sort-by-game presets.
- Hand scanning: the iOS and Android apps scan cards with the phone camera, with or without a sorter.
- Collection tracking: card counts, value with daily history, cost basis, storage boxes with each card's position, CSV import and export.
- Buying and selling: intake of collections over the counter, shop catalogs, trade links, reservations and pick lists (Business plan).
- Pricing: a free plan for casual sorting; paid Enthusiast and Business plans raise limits and add features.
- Hosting: hosted at mault.xyz, or self-hosted with Docker Compose, Coolify or on a Raspberry Pi.
- Hardware: an ESP32-S3 or Arduino Uno R4 board, a PCA9685 servo driver, SG90 servos and IR sensors in 3D printed modules. Kits are sold at shop.mault.xyz.
- Open source: the web app, API, mobile app, firmware and 3D model are in one GitHub repository.

## Guides

- [Home](https://mault.xyz/): what Mault does, supported games, features and pricing
- [Build guide](https://mault.xyz/build): bill of materials, wiring diagrams, 3D printed parts, firmware and step-by-step assembly of the sorting machine
- [Self-hosting guide](https://mault.xyz/self-host): running Mault with Docker Compose, Coolify or on a Raspberry Pi or Linux host
- [Discord bot](https://mault.xyz/discord-bot): posting sorted cards, sorter alerts and collection stats to a Discord server
- [Desktop app](https://mault.xyz/download): the Windows and Linux app that keeps scanning in the background

## Source and community

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/maultxyz/mault): source code, releases, firmware and the 3D model
- [Public API documentation](https://github.com/maultxyz/mault/blob/master/docs/public-api.md): the Scryfall-style REST API for collections and cards
- [3D print files on MakerWorld](https://makerworld.com/en/models/3066180-tcg-card-sorting-machine)
- [Discord community](https://discord.gg/fYvw5PcvGg)
